get.summary: List accounts, one page at a time
get.description: Returns one page of accounts in ascending identifier order, which for the UUIDv7 identifiers the module generates is close to creation order. Deleted accounts (tombstones) are left out unless the status filter asks for them. Every accepted filter given an empty value means no filter, and the query parameter set is closed: a parameter not declared here is refused with 400 rather than ignored. Requires the account.read action on the platform scope.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters by account status: disabled, active or deleted. Absent or empty selects every status except deleted; deleted selects the tombstones. Any other value is 400.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filters by account kind: user or service. Absent or empty selects both; any other value is 400.

parameters.name: identifier_prefix
parameters.description: Filters by the leading part of one identifier of the kind named in identifier_kind. The prefix is normalized the way stored identifiers are (a username lower-cased, an email address trimmed and lower-cased) and must be at least 3 characters. It must be given together with identifier_kind; one without the other is 400.

parameters.name: identifier_kind
parameters.description: The identifier kind the prefix applies to: username, email or phone. Required whenever identifier_prefix is given, and refused without it.

parameters.name: display_name_prefix
parameters.description: The account's display name by its leading bytes, case-sensitive; must be valid UTF-8 text; absent or empty selects every display name

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, or empty for the first page. The cursor is the identifier of the last account on that page, and the page is read by it rather than by an offset.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. Absent or 0 takes the default of 100; a value above 1000 is capped at 1000 rather than refused; a negative or non-integer value is 400.

200.description: The page of accounts and the next cursor

400.description: The list's query could not be read, or a query parameter the route does not accept

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read accounts

post.description: Creates a user or a service account. A user account must name at least one login identifier in this request — username, email or phone — because an account without one could not sign in; a service account signs in with a service secret and is not held to that. An email address or phone number is written with the way the administrator may state (admin or import-unverified), never with a proof of ownership. Creating a service account additionally needs the client.manage action. The mandatory audit row is written before the account row.

requestBody.description: The account to create. kind is required; a user account also names at least one of username, email and phone, and email and phone each carry a verification channel in email_verified_via and phone_verified_via.

400.description: The body could not be read, or an argument is invalid

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not create accounts

409.description: An account with that identifier already exists

get.description: Reads one account by its identifier. A deleted account reads as not found, as does an identifier that never existed. Requires the account.read action, with the account as both the decision's target and target account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read the account

patch.description: Writes the display name, the whole attribute set and the protected flag, each only when the request names it; a field left out is left as it is. protected is a host's mark that the account may not be impersonated, independent of any Decider. Requires account.update.

requestBody.description: The fields to write. Every field is optional and each one left out leaves the stored value unchanged; attributes replaces the whole set rather than merging into it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read, or an argument is invalid

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not update the account

delete.description: Deletes the account and erases its personal data, leaving a tombstone that keeps the identifier, kind, status and creation time: identifiers, external bindings, password credential, service secrets and memberships are removed. Requires account.delete and a fresh local multi-factor authentication from the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not delete the account

post.description: Disables or restores an account; status is active or disabled. The deleted state is reached only through the delete route and is refused here. Requires account.disable and a fresh local multi-factor authentication. Sessions of a disabled account are cleaned up synchronously; a cleanup failure answers 503 while the status change stands, and retrying the same request completes the cleanup idempotently.

requestBody.description: The status to set. Only active and disabled are accepted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

200.description: The account at its new status

400.description: The body could not be read, or names no known status

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not change the status

post.summary: Add an identifier to an account
post.description: Adds a login name (username) or an email address to the account. The identifier is recorded as administrator-asserted (verified_via admin) and is not evidence of ownership, so it does not by itself justify automatic linking or merging. A phone number is refused here: it is added or changed only through an SMS code. Requires account.update.

requestBody.description: The identifier to add. kind is username or email and value is its text; the value is normalized before it is stored, so a username is lower-cased and an email address is trimmed and lower-cased.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the identifier is malformed

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not add the identifier

delete.summary: Remove an identifier from an account
delete.description: Removes the identifier named by its own identifier (the identifier row's id, not its value) from the account. Removing an identifier the account does not hold succeeds without changing anything. Requires account.update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The identifier's own identifier, as the profile surface reports it; not the identifier's value.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not remove the identifier

404.description: No such account; an identifier the account does not hold is already unbound and answers 204

post.description: Sets a temporary password that the account must change at its next sign-in, then revokes every session of the account. The revocation runs after the password write, so its failure is logged and does not undo the reset. The password is never echoed, logged or audited. Requires account.update, a fresh local non-SMS multi-factor authentication and a seasoned factor of the caller's own; a caller without one gets 403 factor-not-seasoned.

requestBody.description: The temporary password. It is written with must_change set, so the account must choose a new one at its next sign-in.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the password fails the policy

401.description: No usable credential, or a step-up is required

403.description: The caller is impersonating, may not reset the password, or has no seasoned non-SMS factor (factor-not-seasoned)

get.description: Lists the account's registered factors as kind, label and status, and nothing of their credentials. Requires account.read.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read the factors

post.summary: Set whether an account must register a factor
post.description: Sets the account-level flag that requires the account to register a factor. Requires account.update.

requestBody.description: The flag to write; an absent required writes false.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not change the flag

post.description: Disables every factor registered on the account, sets the account's mfa_required flag so it must register a factor again, revokes every session of the account, and answers how many factors were removed. Requires mfa.reset, a fresh local non-SMS multi-factor authentication and a seasoned non-SMS factor of the caller's own; a caller without one gets 403 factor-not-seasoned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

401.description: No usable credential, or a step-up is required

403.description: The caller is impersonating, may not reset the factors, or has no seasoned non-SMS factor (factor-not-seasoned)

get.description: Lists the account's live browser and token sessions, most recently created first, without any credential or token material. Each row's current is true when it is the caller's own session. Requires session.read.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read the sessions

post.summary: Revoke every session of an account
post.description: Revokes every unrevoked browser and token session of the account, including one whose deadline has already passed, and answers with the number revoked. One audit row per session is written before the revocation, so the set read and the set revoked are the same; an account with nothing in that set revokes nothing and writes nothing. Requires session.revoke. Retrying is idempotent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not revoke the sessions

delete.summary: Revoke one session by its identifier
delete.description: Revokes one session by its identifier. The session is read first to learn its account, which fills the decision's target account. Requires session.revoke. Revoking an already revoked session succeeds with the same answer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The session's identifier.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not revoke the session

get.description: Lists the account's service secrets oldest first, as identifier, label, absolute expiry and revocation state; the secret value itself is never returned. Requires account.read.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read the secrets

post.summary: Create a service secret for an account
post.description: Mints a service secret for a service account; only a service account has them, so any other account is 400. The secret value is returned in this response only and can never be read again. An expiry, when given, must be in the future. Requires client.manage and a fresh local multi-factor authentication.

requestBody.description: The secret to mint. label may be absent or empty, in which case the secret carries an empty label; an absent expires_at mints a secret with no expiry.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

201.description: The secret's identifier, label, one-time secret and expiry

400.description: The body could not be read

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not create the secret

delete.description: Revokes the service secret named by its identifier, not by the secret value. Requires client.manage and a fresh local multi-factor authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The service secret's identifier, not the secret value.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not revoke the secret

get.description: Lists one tenant's memberships, one page at a time, in ascending account-identifier order. The path names the tenant identifier itself, not an alias: the module holds no tenant roster and does not look the tenant up, and the same identifier is the decision's tenant. Requires membership.manage.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. Absent or 0 takes the default of 100; a value above 1000 is capped at 1000 rather than refused; a negative or non-integer value is 400.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The account identifier of the last membership on the previous page, or empty for the first page.

400.description: The page query could not be read

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read memberships

put.summary: Write an account's membership in a tenant
put.description: Writes one account's membership in one tenant: active true adds or resumes it and active false suspends it, and a suspended membership reads as no membership. source records how it came to exist; omitted records it as an administrator's change. The account must exist and not be a tombstone. Requires membership.manage with the path's tenant.

requestBody.description: The membership to write. active, sso_exempt and source are all optional on the wire, but an absent active writes false, which suspends the membership.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read, an unknown field included, the tenant is invalid, or source is longer than 128 bytes. The module has no role.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not write memberships

delete.summary: Remove an account's membership from a tenant
delete.description: Removes the account's membership from the tenant. Requires membership.manage with the path's tenant. The route is idempotent: a membership that is not there is already removed, and the call answers 204.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not remove memberships

put.summary: Set an account's exemption from a tenant's SSO requirement
put.description: Sets or clears a member's emergency exemption from the tenant's enforced SSO requirement. The membership must already exist: an absent one is 404, and the route changes only the exemption, leaving the rest of the membership as it is. Requires membership.manage.

requestBody.description: The exemption flag to write; false clears the exemption.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: The account's identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

400.description: The body could not be read

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not write the exemption

get.description: Lists the tenant's SSO providers. The encrypted client secret never appears. Requires idp.manage with the path's tenant.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read providers

post.summary: Create an SSO provider in a tenant
post.description: Creates an SSO provider in the tenant. The path and the body must agree on the tenant: an absent body tenant takes the path's, and a different one is 400. protocol is oidc or saml; provisioning is jit or preprovisioned and has no default. A client secret is carried only by an OIDC provider. Every write raises the provider's version. Requires idp.manage.

requestBody.description: The provider to create. protocol, name, provisioning and config are required; the config is validated against the protocol and an unknown key is refused.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant's identifier (the tenant module's ID as a string), not an alias or a display name.

400.description: The body could not be read, or an argument is invalid

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not create providers

get.description: Reads one provider by its identifier. The provider's own tenant, resolved from the store, is the decision's tenant. The encrypted client secret never appears. Requires idp.manage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read the provider

put.description: A full write of the provider: protocol, name, provisioning and config must be present, and the config is validated with unknown keys refused. Booleans left out keep their stored value, and an omitted client_secret keeps the stored one. The tenant is immutable: a body naming another tenant is 400. Requires idp.manage; each write raises version.

requestBody.description: The provider to write. protocol, name, provisioning and config are required; booleans left out keep their stored value, and an absent client_secret keeps the stored one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

400.description: The body could not be read, or an argument is invalid

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not update the provider

delete.description: Deletes the provider. Requires idp.manage, with the provider's own tenant as the decision's tenant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not delete the provider

post.summary: Claim a domain for an SSO provider
post.description: Claims a domain for the provider and answers the verification token to publish in the domain's DNS TXT record; the claim stays unverified until the verify route finds that record. Requires idp.manage. A domain another provider has already verified is 409; an unverified claim by another provider may stand beside this one.

requestBody.description: The domain to claim, for example example.com. It is trimmed and lower-cased before it is stored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

400.description: The body could not be read, or the domain field is empty. A non-empty domain that is not well formed is refused by the domain normalizer, whose failure this route does not map and answers 503.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not claim domains

409.description: Another provider has already verified the domain; an unverified claim by another provider may stand beside this one

delete.summary: Remove a domain from an SSO provider
delete.description: Removes a claimed domain, verified or not, from the provider. Requires idp.manage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The claimed domain name.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not write domains

404.description: No such provider; removing a claim the provider does not hold succeeds without changing anything and answers 204

post.summary: Verify a claimed domain of an SSO provider
post.description: Verifies a claimed domain by looking up the TXT record that must hold the verification token and, when it does, marks the claim verified. A domain the provider holds no claim on, or a record that does not hold the token, marks nothing verified. Requires idp.manage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The claimed domain name.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not write domains

404.description: No such provider; a domain with no claim and a TXT record without the token are not mapped by this route and answer 503

409.description: Another provider has verified the domain, so the uniqueness index refuses this verification

post.summary: Re-verify every claimed domain of an SSO provider
post.description: Re-runs verification for every domain the provider has verified; a claim that was never verified is not looked up. Requires idp.manage.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not write domains

post.description: Refreshes the provider's metadata by dispatching to the refresher registered for its protocol. A protocol with no refresher in this assembly is 400, and a provider with no metadata URL cannot be refreshed. On a parse or validation failure the stored config is kept and the failure is answered. Requires idp.manage; a successful refresh writes the new config and raises version.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The provider's identifier.

400.description: The provider's protocol has no registered refresher in this assembly, or its stored config cannot be decoded. The request carries no body.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not refresh metadata

get.summary: List impersonation records, one page at a time
get.description: Lists the impersonation records of the tenant named by the required tenant query parameter, one page at a time, in ascending record-identifier order. The tenant scopes the read and fills the decision's tenant, so the page holds only that tenant's records and the cursor counts them. Records are never deleted, and a record still in force whose deadline has passed is evaluated and stored as ended before it is returned. Requires impersonation.read.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: The tenant whose records the page holds, as the tenant identifier; it scopes the read and fills the decision's tenant. Required: absent or empty is 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. Absent or 0 takes the default of 100; a value above 1000 is capped at 1000 rather than refused; a negative or non-integer value is 400.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, or empty for the first page; the cursor is the identifier of the last record on that page.

200.description: The page of records and the next cursor

400.description: The page query could not be read

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not read records

delete.description: Revokes an impersonation record; the record is read first, including an already ended one, to learn its tenant and target, which fill the decision. Revoking a record that has already ended is a no-op and gets the same answer as the first revocation. This route writes no mandatory audit: revoking is a move in the safe direction, and the impersonation module writes its own best-effort row. Requires impersonation.revoke.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The impersonation record's identifier.

403.description: The caller is impersonating or may not revoke records

AuthnAdminAccount.description: One account as the management routes show it, built field by field so that a field added to the stored account does not reach a client by being there.

id.description: The account's opaque identifier: 1 to 64 bytes from [A-Za-z0-9._-], case-sensitive.

kind.description: user for a human account, service for a non-interactive API client.

status.description: disabled, active or deleted; deleted is terminal and leaves a tombstone.

display_name.description: The account's display name, at most 100 characters and not used for any decision.

mfa_required.description: True when the account must register a factor before it can sign in.

protected.description: True when the account may not be impersonated, independent of any Decider.

password_set.description: True when the account carries a password credential.

attributes.description: Absent when the account carries no attribute set

created_at.description: When the account was created, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

AuthnAdminAccountList.description: One page of accounts and the cursor of the next page.

accounts.description: The accounts on this page, in ascending identifier order.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, empty on the last page

AuthnAdminFactor.description: One registered factor: its kind, label and status, and nothing of its credential.

kind.description: The factor kind: totp, sms or webauthn.

label.description: The label the account gave the factor, for display only.

status.description: pending until the factor is confirmed, then active; disabled once it can no longer be used.

AuthnAdminFactorList.description: The factors registered on one account.

factors.description: The account's registered factors; the empty array when it has none.

AuthnAdminRemoved.description: The number of factors a multi-factor reset removed.

AuthnAdminSession.description: One session of an account, without any credential a caller could use to take it over.

kind.description: The session kind: browser for a cookie session, token for an access and refresh token pair.

auth_time.description: When the session last authenticated, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

impersonation_id.description: Absent unless the session carries an impersonation

created_at.description: When the session was created, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

last_seen_at.description: When a request last used the session, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

expires_at.description: The session's absolute expiry, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

revoked.description: True when the session has been revoked.

current.description: True when the row is the caller's own session

AuthnAdminSessionList.description: The live sessions of one account, most recently created first.

sessions.description: The account's live browser and token sessions, most recently created first; the empty array when it has none.

AuthnAdminRevoked.description: The number of sessions a bulk revocation ended.

AuthnAdminSecret.description: One service secret as the listing shows it: identifier, label, expiry and revocation state, never the secret value.

id.description: The secret's identifier, not the secret value.

label.description: The label given to the secret when it was created.

expires_at.description: When the secret expires, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC; the zero instant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z means it never expires.

revoked.description: True when the secret has been revoked.

AuthnAdminSecretList.description: The service secrets of one account, oldest first.

secrets.description: The account's service secrets, oldest first; the empty array when it has none.

AuthnAdminSecretCreated.description: A freshly minted service secret. The secret value appears in this response only.

label.description: The label given in the request.

secret.description: The secret itself, handed out once and never again

expires_at.description: The zero instant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when the request named no expiry

AuthnAdminMember.description: One account's membership in one tenant.

active.description: True when the membership is in force; false means suspended, which reads as not a member.

sso_exempt.description: True when the member is exempt from the tenant's enforced SSO requirement.

source.description: How the membership came to exist: admin, invite, import or jit:<provider identifier>.

AuthnAdminMemberList.description: One page of a tenant's memberships, in ascending account-identifier order.

members.description: The memberships on this page; the empty array when the tenant has none.

AuthnAdminProvider.description: One SSO provider. The encrypted client secret never appears, and warnings names each setting that loosens a default.

tenant.description: The owning tenant's identifier; immutable after creation.

name.description: The provider's display name; 1 to 64 characters.

enabled.description: True when the provider may be used for sign-in.

provisioning.description: jit creates an account on first sign-in; preprovisioned matches only an account an administrator has already created.

trust_idp_mfa.description: True when the provider's assertion may count as a multi-factor proof, and only when its acr (or SAML AuthnContextClassRef) is in the configured list.

allow_idp_initiated.description: True when an unsolicited assertion from the provider is accepted; the route then warns that login CSRF cannot be defended against.

allow_sha1.description: True when SHA-1 signed assertions are accepted; the route then warns about the downgrade.

merge_existing.description: True when just-in-time sign-up may merge into an existing account; the route then warns about it.

config.description: The protocol's own configuration; absent when the provider carries none

version.description: The provider's version, raised by every write.

warnings.description: Absent when no setting loosens a default

AuthnAdminProviderEnvelope.description: A response carrying one SSO provider.

AuthnAdminProviderList.description: The SSO providers of one tenant.

providers.description: The tenant's providers; the empty array when it has none.

AuthnAdminVerifyToken.description: The token to publish in DNS to verify a claimed domain.

verify_token.description: The token to publish in DNS

AuthnAdminImpersonation.description: One impersonation record. The reason never appears here; it is in the record and the audit row alone.

actor.description: The identifier of the account that started the impersonation.

target.description: The identifier of the account being impersonated.

tenant.description: The tenant the impersonation is confined to.

session_id.description: The identifier of the actor's session that carries the impersonation.

started_at.description: When the impersonation started, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

ends_at.description: When the impersonation lapses, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

ended_at.description: The zero instant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z while the record is still in force

end_reason.description: Absent while the record is still in force

AuthnAdminImpersonationList.description: One page of impersonation records of one tenant, in ascending record-identifier order, and the cursor of the next page.

impersonations.description: The records on this page; the empty array when the tenant has none.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, empty on the last page

AuthnAdminAccountCreate.description: The request that creates an account. A user account must name at least one of username, email and phone.

kind.description: user for a human account, service for a non-interactive API client.

display_name.description: The account's display name; absent writes an empty one.

username.description: A login name to add. At least one of username, email and phone is required for a user account; a username is lower-cased before it is stored.

email.description: An email address to add, asserted by the administrator. It is trimmed and lower-cased before it is stored, and it needs email_verified_via.

email_verified_via.description: How the administrator states the email came to be verified: admin or import-unverified. It is required whenever email is present, because an address written here is always recorded as verified; empty or absent is refused with 400.

phone.description: A phone number to add, in E.164 with a leading plus sign and 7 to 15 digits; it needs phone_verified_via.

phone_verified_via.description: How the administrator states the phone came to be verified: admin or import-unverified. It is required whenever phone is present, because a number written here is always recorded as verified; empty or absent is refused with 400.

password.description: An initial password; absent leaves the account without one. It must pass the password policy.

mfa_required.description: True when the account must register a factor before it can sign in.

AuthnAdminAccountPatch.description: A partial update: every field is optional, and each one left out leaves the stored value as it is.

display_name.description: Absent leaves the display name as it is

attributes.description: Absent leaves the attribute set as it is

protected.description: Absent leaves the protected flag as it is

AuthnAdminAccountStatus.description: The request that changes an account's status.

status.description: The deleted state is reached only through the delete route

AuthnAdminIdentifierWrite.description: The request that adds one identifier to an account.

kind.description: A phone number is added or changed only through an SMS code and is refused here

value.description: The identifier's text; it is normalized before it is stored, so a username is lower-cased and an email address is trimmed and lower-cased.

verified_via.description: How the administrator states the identifier came to be verified

AuthnAdminMFARequired.description: The request that sets the account-level required-factor flag.

required.description: True when the account must register a factor before it can sign in.

AuthnAdminPasswordReset.description: The request that sets an administrator's temporary password.

password.description: The temporary password, handed out once and never echoed, logged or audited

AuthnAdminSecretCreate.description: The request that mints a service secret.

label.description: The label for the administrator's own reference: at most 100 bytes of valid UTF-8 with no control character.

expires_at.description: Absent mints a secret with no expiry

AuthnAdminMemberWrite.description: The request that writes a membership. An absent active writes false.

active.description: True adds or resumes the membership; false suspends it, and a suspended membership reads as not a member.

source.description: Absent records the change as an administrator's

sso_exempt.description: True exempts the member from the tenant's enforced SSO requirement.

AuthnAdminMemberSSOExempt.description: The request that sets or clears a member's exemption from the tenant's SSO requirement.

sso_exempt.description: True exempts the member; false clears the exemption.

AuthnAdminProviderWrite.description: The request that creates or replaces an SSO provider. Booleans left out keep their stored value on an update and are false on a create, and config is required either way.

tenant.description: Absent on a create takes the path's tenant; a value that names another is refused

protocol.description: The protocol: oidc or saml. The set is closed.

name.description: The provider's display name; 1 to 64 characters.

enabled.description: Absent leaves the enabled flag as it is (false on a create)

provisioning.description: jit creates an account on first sign-in; preprovisioned matches only an account an administrator has already created. Required, with no default.

trust_idp_mfa.description: Absent leaves the flag as it is (false on a create)

allow_idp_initiated.description: Absent leaves the flag as it is (false on a create)

allow_sha1.description: Absent leaves the flag as it is (false on a create)

merge_existing.description: Absent leaves the flag as it is (false on a create)

client_secret.description: Absent writes no client secret on a create and keeps the stored one on an update

AuthnAdminDomainClaim.description: The request that claims a domain for an SSO provider.

domain.description: The domain to claim, for example example.com; it is trimmed and lower-cased before it is stored.
